ablation_semantics: decision contribution disabled; stored subsystem state retained

matrix.claim_boundary: Stage 4 attributes decision-path contribution on the frozen Stage-3 matrix only. A disabled weight removes a channel from action scoring but does not delete its stored subsystem state. Results do not establish general Ghost superiority or production value.

next_experiment: Use Stage-4 causal findings to choose either simplification/removal probes or broader adversarial scaling; do not increase difficulty merely to manufacture a Ghost advantage.
stage4_non_claim: Stage 4 does not establish general Ghost superiority, realism, intelligence, production value, or uniqueness. Disabling a decision weight is not the same as deleting subsystem storage. The unchanged strong baseline remains an external 30/30 comparator.
stage4_supported_claim: On the exact frozen Stage-3 matrix, the recorded Ghost decision changes under pre-registered decision-path ablations identify which tested contributions were behaviorally causal, redundant, or unnecessary for those checkpoints.
